description: 挂盒主图开场，用空白适配表与样张讲清输出与适配

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF for packshots, cool grey-blue panel #E9EEF3 for infographic screens, one deep charcoal #1C1F23 sweep for the close, all with hard edge-free falloff
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright neutral-cool high-key studio light, front-left key with fill card, soft short contact shadows, no harsh speculars, every device display left blank and unlit
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale laminate counter #F2F4F6, plain matte paper stacks, unprinted kraft parcel surface and a woven jute threshold mat #B99A6B
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline band per screen, wide letter spacing, all copy carried by placeholders only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, square-cornered ribbon bars and empty badge frames in the locked palette, no pictograms that carry brand meaning
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 packshot angle and identical cartridge scale across the set, packaging faces kept as blank fields with empty badge frames, compatible device bodies always unbranded and unprinted
noDrift: no legible words inside printed samples or on packaging faces
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium office-consumables ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, cool grey-blue panel #E9EEF3, deep charcoal #1C1F23 and one bright cyan accent #1B9DDD; neutral-cool high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, fill card and soft short contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline band per screen; thin single-weight line icons, square-cornered ribbon bars and empty badge frames only; clean high-end packshot photography mixed with minimal blank infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 product angle and identical product scale; compatible device bodies always blank, unbranded and unlit; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：源 12 张均为 1:1 方图，白底信息图排版（顶部大标题带 + 底部实物）。001 黑色挂孔零售盒 3/4 主图；002 新旧包装并列带箭头；003 盒与墨盒单元并列 + 圆底勾选徽标 + 下方多行机型清单；004 门口双手放下牛皮纸快递盒、编织地垫与散落样张；005 两叠白纸高度差对比、盒置于纸叠顶端、两条色底标签带；006 两把圆形放大镜压在彩色与黑白样张上；007 两叠扇形展开的打印页（菜谱与海报版式）；008 顶视打印机与出纸、三类打印成品扇铺；009 打印机吐出斑驳退化页 + 三角警示圆徽；010 手把旧墨盒放入白色回寄袋（袋面三行图文说明）；011 黑壳与彩壳两枚墨盒并列 + 大字号百分比 + 捧在手心的再生塑料碎片；012 四只压扁透明瓶成排 + 大字号数量标题。合并：007 与 008 合成第 2 镜样张卖点；011 拆为第 8 镜双盒选装与第 9 镜回收信任；012 并入第 10 镜收口；002 的新旧包装对照主张不保留，仅把挂孔盒结构留给第 1 镜空白盒面。品类判定：产品是喷墨打印机耗材墨盒，归属打印设备耗材，故 L1 逐字取「电脑办公」、L2 逐字取「办公设备」，与源提示类目一致；未取「家居日用」的办公文具耗材，也未取「家用电器」（本品无电驱部件）。已剥离：原品牌字与系列名、盒面型号数字与花叶装饰图、适配机型清单与页数产量数值、新旧包装改版主张与箭头、百分比与塑料瓶数量标题、订阅与回收计划名称、联系电话与网址、回寄袋图文说明文字、样张上全部可读文字、二维码与条码、平台徽章与星级角标、原平台店铺字样与脚注法律文本、设备屏面读数（改为空白无读数面板）。适配信息改为空白两列四行对照表，利益点与标签改为空指示条与空徽标框，图内主张一律以 {selling_point_n} / {callout_n} 占位，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
